description: Add referer domains to the account's allow/block list for playback (POST /library/{id}?action=refer) and optionally turn domain protection on or off (block_none_refer). block_none_refer is applied first and rewrites the status of ALL the library's domains: true activates every domain (including ones turned off on purpose), false deactivates all of them and lets every request play; it is refused while a domain is still pending. With protection off, the new domains are created inactive. Resolves the library ID automatically. dry_run=true (default) previews.

block_none_refer.description: If set, turn domain protection on (true: active domains apply, all domains are activated) or off (false: all domains are deactivated)

name: panda_action_set_allowed_domains
title: Set Allowed/Blocked Domains
